about: Day 1 (leaving home): the family home's styles, picked from the student's 'From' answer. Add a style here and map 'From' answers to it; no code changes. Models are names inside the kit files in public/models/home/ (scripts/home-assets.mjs). Colours are South African palettes: roofs, walls and paint are recoloured at load.

breakfast.label: Eggs, boerewors and toast, with a mug of rooibos

lines.wake: Last morning in my own bed. UMzansi today.
lines.window: {neighbour} is watering her roses again. {dog} is pacing the yard like she knows.
lines.downstairs: Smells like boerewors. {call} is up early.
lines.parentHello: There's my university student! Sit. Nobody leaves this house on an empty stomach.
lines.embarrass: I put a photo of you in your suitcase, the one in the bath, so you don't forget home. And I told the family WhatsApp group. Uncle David sent forty emojis.
lines.sibling: So... can I have your room now?
lines.bags: Everything I own, in one suitcase and a backpack.
lines.car: Come, we'll beat the traffic on the N3.
lines.drive: {call} drives. The street goes by: the wall, the jacaranda, {neighbour} waving the hose.
lines.gate2: Phone me tonight. And eat properly, not just noodles.
lines.money: Here. R{amount}. For food, not for parties.
lines.gate3: Go on, then. Make us proud.

replies.label: It's still my room.
replies.answer: Ugh, fine. I'm still borrowing your speaker.

replies.label: Only if you walk {dog} every day.
Take it. Don't touch my stuff.

breakfast.label: Ma's vetkoek with eggs and sweet tea

lines.wake: Last morning in my own bed. UMzansi today.
lines.window: {neighbour} is watering her mielies again. {dog} is pacing the yard like he knows.
lines.downstairs: Vetkoek. Ma has been up since five.
lines.parentHello: Here is my university child! Sit, sit. Eat first, then you can be clever.
lines.embarrass: I wrote your name in every vest. In marker. Big letters. And on Sunday the whole church prayed for you, by name, with your matric photo on the screen.
lines.sibling: So... can I have your room now?
lines.bags: Everything I own, in one suitcase and a backpack.
lines.car: Come, my child. Uncle lent us the car till twelve.
lines.drive: Ma drives slowly. The street waves: {neighbour}, the spaza, the kids by the high mast.
lines.gate2: Phone me tonight. And eat properly, not just noodles.
lines.money: Here. R{amount}. For food, not for parties.
lines.gate3: Go well, my child. Make us proud.

replies.label: It's still my room.
replies.answer: Eish. Fine. I'm still using your charger.

replies.label: Only if you feed {dog} every day.
Take it. Don't touch my stuff.
